finding.title: Create or remove the dangling docs/appcheck-enforcement.md reference in docs/coding-standards.md

evidence.quote: ...enforcement flips only after CI/device tokens are registered and metrics reviewed, recorded in `docs/appcheck-enforcement.md`.

finding.why: docs/appcheck-enforcement.md does not exist anywhere in the repo — PV-6's enforcement-status process points at a record that was never created. Given the project's known App Check debug-token fragility (wipes regenerate the token and cause 403/permission-denied outages), the absence of any recorded enforcement-status process for a fragile, security-relevant subsystem is more than pure hygiene.
finding.recommendation: Either create docs/appcheck-enforcement.md recording current App Check enforcement status, or remove the dangling pointer from PV-6 until the doc exists.
acceptance_criteria: docs/appcheck-enforcement.md exists, or coding-standards.md:349 no longer references it

finding.title: Regenerate index.md/project-overview.md/source-tree-analysis.md's DB-schema, feature-list and file-count inventory — frozen before the Epic 24-27 rebuild
finding.area: docs (index.md, project-overview.md, source-tree-analysis.md) vs core/database, features/

evidence.quote: Three-database schema (User DB 23 tables, Content DB 3 tables, Device Registry DB 2 tables)
Three databases: User DB (23 tables, schema v4) + Content DB (3 tables, read-only, v3) + Device Registry DB (2 tables, v1)
**Codebase snapshot:** ~366 source files, 182 test files, 18 feature modules.
- **User DB** — schema v4, 23 tables, 20 DAOs, read-write, per-account file.
├── story_acceptance/         # Epic-based acceptance tests (15 files, 401 tests)

finding.why: These three docs (all required 'read in this order' reading per index.md itself) describe a codebase that no longer exists: there is no app_database.dart (it is lib/core/database/user/user_database.dart, class UserDatabase, schemaVersion 32 with 24 tables and 24 registered DAOs, not v4/v15 with 23 tables/20 DAOs); the Content DB has 4 tables (daily_content is missing from every doc's list) at schema v5, not 3 at v3; the feature list is 18 old names (auth, parent_mode, learning_order, stages, test_tracking, track_setup, tutor_mode) when lib/features/ actually has 15 (account, sacred_time, tracks, tutoring, etc. — several renamed/merged); test/story_acceptance/ has 57 files today, not 15; and the ~366/182 file counts are roughly half the current 720 hand-written lib files / 780 test files. A contributor or agent using these docs to reason about the schema, DAOs, or feature boundaries will build a wrong mental model and can violate layering rules unknowingly (e.g. importing a dropped table's companion class, as testing-guide.md's own examples do — see the paired finding).
finding.recommendation: Re-run the document-project/architecture-scan workflow that originally produced these three files against current HEAD (it already exists and was used once, per docs/project-scan-report.json) rather than hand-patching individual numbers, since nearly every count in the DB/feature/file sections has drifted.
acceptance_criteria: schema table counts, DAO counts, and feature list in all three docs match the @DriftDatabase tables:/daos: lists and lib/features/ directory at time of merge
add these three files to the AG-8 'update paired doc in the same PR' checklist for schema/feature-reorg changes

finding.title: Reconcile project-overview.md's Project-status table with linear-status.md — Epics 21 and 23 wrongly shown 'delivered'

evidence.quote: **As of 2026-04-19** — sourced from [`docs/linear-status.md`](./linear-status.md), which is the canonical epic/story status document.
| DNI-238 | 21 — Multi-Account Device — Account Switching, Session Management & Deletion | 0 | Backlog |
| DNI-278 | 23 — Manual QA Verification | 18 | Canceled (all stories Canceled) |

finding.why: project-overview.md's own Project-status table cites docs/linear-status.md as its source, but the two directly disagree: project-overview.md lists Epic 21 (Multi-Account Device) and Epic 23 (Manual QA Verification) as 'delivered (production)', while linear-status.md — in the same batch, itself the more detailed and internally self-consistent doc — shows Epic 21 has 0 stories and is Backlog, and Epic 23's 18 stories are all Canceled. project-overview.md also never mentions the Epic 24-27 Greenfield Rebuild at all, even though linear-status.md states that rebuild superseded nearly everything before it. A reader trusting project-overview.md's summary (the first doc in the required read-in-order path) gets an actively wrong picture of what has shipped.
finding.recommendation: Replace the static Project-status table with either a one-line pointer to linear-status.md (avoiding a second copy that can drift) or regenerate it from status/sprint-status.yaml, and add a note that the Epic 24-27 Greenfield Rebuild superseded the pre-24 epic set.
acceptance_criteria: project-overview.md's epic-status claims match linear-status.md's current table, or the section is replaced with a pointer instead of a duplicated table
